# Vibe Memory

> Vibe Memory is an open-source shared memory layer for AI agents. It stores agent-authored memories, entities, relationships, document metadata, opaque byte-stream files, and encrypted Vault entries without calling an LLM.

Canonical site: https://vibememory.io/
Source: https://github.com/vibememory/vibememory
License: MIT

## Public documentation

- Connection guide: https://vibememory.io/guide
- Support: https://vibememory.io/support
- OpenAPI schema: https://vibememory.io/openapi.json
- Live Skill: https://vibememory.io/skills/vibe-memory/SKILL.md
- Skill manifest: https://vibememory.io/skills/vibe-memory/manifest.json
- Agent support matrix: https://vibememory.io/#agent-support

## Product boundaries

- Vibe Memory does not call an LLM or infer entities and relationships.
- Connected agents analyze content, choose keywords, infer entities and relationships, and submit structured data.
- The service embeds only supplied keywords locally; it does not embed source text or assemble RAG context.
- Original files are uploaded as application/octet-stream byte streams and are not analyzed or chunked by the service.
- Canonical timestamps are UTC.

## Integrations

- Remote MCP endpoint: https://vibememory.io/mcp
- Native Rust CLI and Skill workflows support Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Muse Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes.
- ChatGPT Work and Claude can connect through MCP.
- Self-hosting is documented in the GitHub repository.
